::: {.why}
An ETF is the first instrument in the year whose price is held in place by someone else's profit motive, and that mechanism is the template for half of what follows.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Describe creation and redemption in the order the steps happen, and name who is paid at each step.
- Say what breaks the mechanism, and name one asset class where the premium or discount routinely gets large.
